trees.name: conversation.input.right
trees.purpose: The right end of the same tool row, before the primary send button — the seat for a control the user reaches on the way to sending (the model select sits in its own named seat just left of here).

catalog.description:
The right end of the same tool row, before the primary send button —
the seat for a control the user reaches on the way to sending (the
model select sits in its own named seat just left of here). Same
InputZone owner share and the same one-row height budget as

registration.name: id
registration.description: Your cell key. Use an id of your own: a fresh id is added beside the shipped entries, while reusing a shipped id puts you in THAT cell and replaces it. Owners that filter by id address you by it.

registration.name: label
registration.description: Display text where the owner projects one (nav rows, tabs). A thunk is re-read on every projection, so localized text follows the active locale without re-registering.
